core.title: 3 Inch Fancy Flower Cabinet Pull, RK International CP-82

text.description_html:
RK International CP-82, 3 Inch Flower Cabinet Door Pull

Available in satin nickel, polished brass, and oil rubbed bronze, the Fancy Flower Cabinet Pull is a beautiful way to add a classic elegance to your home. Every inch of the floral design is carefully crafted with an attention to detail even down to the leaves that make up the sides of this cabinet handle. It comes packaged with all necessary mounting hardware.

Also Available Matching: CK-182 Fancy Flower Cabinet Knob and BP-382 Fancy Flower Cabinet Backpull

Specifications and Features of the RK International CP 82 Flower Pull:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 4-1/4"
  • Width: 7/8"
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
